verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.name.com/llms.txt and markdown docs pages that point agents to that index. Every docs page is also served as .md, there is an agent-oriented skill.md, and a read-only docs MCP server lets agents search and cite the API documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
